packs.name: Lilium HDR shaders
packs.description: HDR analysis, inverse tone mapping, brightness and black floor tools. Needs an HDR game, or one forced to scRGB / HDR10.

packs.name: Pumbo AutoHDR
packs.description: AutoHDR-style shader that expands an SDR image into HDR. Works best when the game renders to a float16 / scRGB buffer.

packs.name: RenoFX
packs.description: RenoFX HDR Toolkit and the SDR compatibility sandwich: brightness, colour, contrast and HDR presentation.

packs.name: MaxG2D simple HDR shaders
packs.description: Simple HDR-aware cinematic effects (motion blur and others) that keep the image above SDR range.

packs.name: ReShade shaders (standard)
packs.description: crosire's collection of post-processing effects, the 'slim' branch ReShade's own setup offers.

packs.name: ReShade shaders (legacy)
packs.description: The older, larger set of effects from crosire's repository (the 'legacy' branch).

packs.name: SweetFX
packs.description: The SweetFX shader suite: SMAA, LumaSharpen, Vibrance, Tonemap and more.

packs.name: qUINT
packs.description: Marty's general-purpose effects: MXAO, SSR, bloom, lightroom, depth of field and others.

packs.name: iMMERSE
packs.description: Marty's Mods Epic ReShade Effects, the successor to qUINT: MXAO, ReLight, SMAA, sharpening and more.

packs.name: prod80 colour effects
packs.description: Colour, contrast and brightness effects, numbered by suggested load order. A large download because of its LUT templates.

packs.name: Daodan shaders
packs.description: Comic, colour-grading and other stylised effects that read the depth buffer.

packs.name: CobraFX
packs.description: SirCobra's shaders for in-game photography. The _CS compute shaders need DirectX 11+, OpenGL 4.3+ or Vulkan.

packs.name: OtisFX
packs.description: Frans Bouma's effects (depth of field, adaptive fog, emphasize, magic bloom and more), kept compatible with current ReShade.

packs.name: AstrayFX
packs.description: Effects that strayed away from the Depth3D repository: Smart Sharp and others.

packs.name: Depth3D
packs.description: SuperDepth3D and other depth-based stereoscopic 3D shaders.

packs.name: ZenteonFX
packs.description: Zenteon's public ReShade shaders. Under the AGNYA licence: read it before sharing anything built with them.
